about.title: About the Rebel Clash set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Rebel Clash is a Sword & Shield expansion released on 1 May 2020. It has 209 cards: 192 in the main set and 17 secret rares. There are also 151 reverse holos.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 192 main set cards), the Master set (343 cards, adding the reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (all 360 cards, adding the 17 secret rares).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
